title: Pet Care Marketing in Seattle | Budgetize

facts.fact: Budgetize's SEO Essentials plan is listed at $399 per month for Seattle pet groomers and vets, with prices in Canadian dollars.
Budgetize's website package is listed at $649 as a one-time charge.
Budgetize gives an 'agency example' price of $1,299 per month as a comparison point next to its own plan.
Budgetize says its $399 per month plan works out to about $13 a day.
facts.quote: About $13 a day. One regular grooming client pays for it.

facts.fact: Budgetize states that prices on the page are in Canadian dollars.
Budgetize states that taxes are added at checkout on top of listed prices.
Budgetize offers a free second month if something is missing from the package in month one.
facts.quote: Anything missing from the box in month one? Month two is free

facts.fact: Budgetize states there is no contract and customers can cancel at any time.
Budgetize says work starts within two business days after ordering.
facts.quote: No contract. No sales call. Work starts within two business days.

facts.fact: Budgetize's first-month process runs as four weekly steps: audit in week 1, service pages in week 2, listing and reviews in week 3, and a report in week 4.
facts.quote: What happens after you pay, week by week. You get an email at every step.

facts.fact: Budgetize's SEO Essentials plan includes two articles a month written by a person.
facts.quote: Two articles a month, written by a person

facts.fact: Budgetize says its monthly report can be read in five minutes.
facts.quote: A report you can read in five minutes

facts.fact: Budgetize's illustrative example shows a 3.1x increase in new-client bookings over four months for an owner of two groomers, using SEO Essentials; the page labels this as illustrative, not a verified result.
Budgetize says its search volume figures are for King County and were checked in week one.
facts.quote: Search volumes are for King County, checked in week one.

facts.fact: Budgetize lists Ballard as a Seattle neighbourhood where its pet-care marketing spot is already taken.
Budgetize lists Bellevue as a nearby suburb where its pet-care marketing spot is already taken.
